caution_findings.evidence_context: Several DBAASP rows give species-level or aggregate values that are compatible with source tables but omit strain scope or conflict with the primary aggregate range; those rows remain source_conflict with context.

The local database packet has no linked_sequence_records and the primary paper presents modified chemical structures rather than a plain linear peptide sequence; the final audit preserves NAI-107 identity without inventing sequence normalization.
linked_assay_records.jsonl and linked_experiment_records.jsonl contain parallel DBAASP rows; both are audited and matched or conflict-preserved rather than collapsed silently.
